data.name: Gordon
data.long_meaning: From the Old Scottish word 'goir' meaning 'stranger' or 'foreigner', and 'don' meaning 'thrown down' or 'son of the chief'. The name Gordon has a long history and is believed to have originated from the Celtic word 'gorr' meaning 'spear' or 'a heavy javelin'. This name was popular among the ancient Scottish clans and is now commonly used as a given name for boys in the English-speaking world.
data.numerology_meaning: Gordon is a name that resonates with the vibrations of courage, leadership, and strength.
